I always wanted to learn saxophone and I was lucky enough to find this place.
You can learn Guitar,Voilen, Keyboard, Ukulele, Drums, Tabla, Saxophone, Flute or any instrument you wish to learn and singing as well. I would recommend this place (Soulful Music Academy) to those willing to be a musician and learn all kinds of musical instruments. Also you can learn music production which is very important aspect in modern music making. I now can play songs on saxophone, and this makes me happy every time I play. Along with saxophone now I am learning more about music. When I joined soulful Music Academy I did not had much knowledge about music, i have learnt so much so far and willing to learn even more. I strongly recommend Soulful Music Academy to anyone who wants to be a professional musician , even if you want to learn as hobby or any one wanting to learn any particular instrument. Along with learning i am having a great music experience. Update: now academy has recording studio.
I am back here to continue with my review. I enrolled here to learn saxophone as I mentioned earlier, however, now I can play saxophone, Ukulele, harmonica and most of all I recorded my 3 songs here. Hoping to learn much more in this journey of music. I started at the right place, the place itself is a vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Shawn Colaco
featured_reviews.review_text:
I enrolled with genuine interest in learning music, but my experience here was extremely disappointing and a complete waste of money.
The teaching lacks structure and consistency, with little to no personalised attention. You simply attend the sessions, but don’t actually learn much or see any meaningful progress.
The overall approach feels purely commercial, more focused on collecting fees than nurturing students or musical growth. For anyone even mildly serious about music, this setup is frustrating and demotivating.
What’s also concerning is that students are actively encouraged to write reviews, which makes many of the glowing ratings feel forced rather than organic. Based on my experience, the reality does not match the online hype.
I regret enrolling and would not recommend this academy to anyone looking for quality music education.

RSIM
